title: Chʼaxwañanakan Jathapa
intro: Janïr akapachan walja chʼaxwäwinakap yatkasaxa, iyawsäwi ukat istʼasirïñ tuqit mä jachʼa yantʼaw utjäna. Aka sarnaqäwix mä sapa jaqin ajlliwinakap uñakipi, jupanakan lurawinakapax jutïr maranakatakix mä nayrïr uñacht’äwiw uñacht’ayi. Mä almax wali envidiasiñampi ukat jan waltʼäwinakampi chʼaxwaski uka sarnaqäwit qhanañchañatakiw wakichtʼasiñama.
clues: Nayajj aka oraqen sarnaqir nayrïr wawanakat maynïrïtwa, nayrïr chacha warmin wawapänwa.
Jilajampix mä sacrificio Allah ukar luqtapxañaw sasaw kamachipxitu, ukax chiqa chuymanïñasat yant’äwiwa.
Nayan ofrendajajj janiw katoqatäkänti, jilajan ofrendapasti janiw katoqatäkänti, ukaw chuymajarojj wali ajjsarkañ chuymamp phoqantäna.
Jilajarojj ajjsarañ arunak arsüyäta, jan walit uñjatäñajj wali qʼañu chuymanïñampiw irpata.
Jilajajj yatiñampi ukat Diosar yupaychasaw jaysäna, Allah chachan cheqapar sarnaqatapa ukat Jupar ajjsarañat amtayitäna.
Jilajajj llampʼu chuymamp parlkchïnjja, perdonañ munaskchïnjja, mä jakäwiw aptʼasiwayta, ukat atipjirinakat maynïriruw tukjjayäta.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
